description.value: A remote backcountry campsite deep in Purcell Wilderness Conservancy Park, reachable only by multi-day foot travel through rugged glaciated terrain with unbridged creek crossings, grizzly country, and no potable water; demands full wilderness self-sufficiency before entry.
